     *  Run this event if the "Buy" or "My Stores" screen exist as chained screens e.g
     *  
     *  Buy
     *  ---
     *  1. Search
     *  2. Following (10)
     *  3. Recently visited (15)
     *  0. Back 
     * 
     *  We run this event so that we can return to the Main menu to
     *  select this recently visited store. This is because stores
     *  that are returned from a list can change order based on
     *  various factors such as:
     *   
     *  1) When picking stores from "Home" > "Show Stores" after a direct mobile 
     *  e.g *250*72000001#, the list of stores can change because stores are
     *  arranged based on the order of visitation.
     * 
     *  2) When picking stores from "Buy" > "Search" > "Show Stores", the list
     *  of stores can change because new stores might be added matching that
     *  search term.
     * 
     *  3) When picking stores from "Buy" > "Following" > "Show Stores", the
     *  list of stores can change because stores are arranged based on the
     *  order of visitation. Also the list of stores can change because we
     *  may unfollow a store.
     * 
     *  4) When picking stores from "Buy" > "Recently visited" > "Show Stores",
     *  the list of stores can change because stores are arranged based on the
     *  order of visitation.
     *   
     *  5) When picking stores from "Sell" i.e "My Stores", the list of stores
     *  can change because stores are arranged based on the order of visitation.
     * 
     *  When we select a store from the list of stores, and the order 
     *  of those stores change, we may end up with undesirable outcomes 
     *  whereby the wrong store is selected instead of the store the user 
     *  was intending to be selected. To prevent this issue, it is better 
     *  we navigate to the Main menu and then select the "recently visited" 
     *  store. Such a store should appear as option 5 on the Main menu e.g 
     *  
     *  1. Buy
     *  2. Sell
     *  3. Lets talk
     *  4. My Account
